title: Nanoworld - Where Small is Big
description: A comprehensive review of nanotechnology and machine learning applications in dentistry, including emerging developments in dental diagnosis, treatment, and patient care.

title: States of Disarray
conference: Creative Activity and Research Day, University of San Francisco
description: Integrated geographic, demographic, and electoral data to create analysis-ready redistricting datasets for all 50 U.S. states. Presented how integrated geographic data and MCMC outlier analysis help detect and understand partisan gerrymandering in elections.
